story: Soomin is in the classroom. Soomin and her friend Mia are making big, colorful pictures. [emotion:QT/surprised] The crayons are on the table, but some crayons are missing! Mia asks the teacher for more crayons. [emotion:QT/happy] Soomin and Mia share the crayons and finish their pictures together.
